description: This source file defines an abstract class 'LocalGamePersistence' responsible for saving, loading, and clearing local game state snapshots for a Ludo game. It handles serialization to JSON and uses shared preferences for persistent storage. It also manages backward compatibility with an older version of the saved data.

classes.name: LocalGamePersistence
classes.description: An abstract final class providing static methods for persisting and retrieving the local game state and configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the game state and match configuration to JSON and saves it under a specific key in shared preferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves the saved game snapshot and configuration, handling both current (v2) and legacy (v1) formats, and returns null if loading fails or data is not present.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the saved game snapshot and legacy data from shared preferences.
